run_GTestXMLOutputUnitTest: run the GTestXMLOutputUnitTest test suite to verify Google Test XML output generation
test_non_empty_xml_output: test that a GTest program generates expected non-empty XML output with test results and failures
test_empty_xml_output: test that a GTest program with no tests generates an empty XML output document
test_filtered_test_xml_output: test XML output when a gtest_filter flag is applied to run only selected tests
test_sharded_test_xml_output: test XML output when running GTest with sharding environment variables for distributed test execution
